title: THENATHE's Vanilla+ Modpack
body:
While this pack is primarily used to connect to my personal server, it also has some features that others might find nice, including:

- Adding a lot of visual improvement effects (Holding items and improved animations, more particle effects, water splash effects)
- Connected textures and the "Stay True" texture pack to give visual intrigue (found on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/stay-true)) as well as the VanillaTweaks texture pack (found on [vanillatweaks.net](https://vanillatweaks.net/)) to give some QoL Changes
- Awesome new animations by FreshLX ([FreshAnimations pack + Addons](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations))
- BSL Shaders
- Tectonic world gen with better structures
- Encouragement to use non-Elytra transportation via a plugin I made myself ([Elytra Boost Blocker, found here](https://github.com/THENATHE/Elytra-Boost-Blocker))
- QoL Improvments including crawling, instamine deepslate with haste, sulker box improvements, chop trees, litematica schematics, a big ol chest, villagers repair golems, and other small tweaks
- Optimizations across the board
- Hopefully getting rid of most of the annoyances of Minecraft without changing the game fundamentally

This modpack is probably very similar to others out there, but I dont like a lot of the extra stuff that goes into Vanilla+, so this is Vanilla>=+
